whispering_forest_light.parent_confirmed_text: Reading 20 minutes: confirmed. A strange light has appeared in Whispering Forest.
whispering_forest_light.child_encounter_text: A strange light is glowing in Whispering Forest. You found Cloudlet!

cloudlet.name: Cloudlet
cloudlet.story: A soft cloud companion that appears near children who keep learning a little every day.

mossprig.name: Mossprig
mossprig.story: A tiny forest friend that quietly helps put scattered things back where they belong.

pebblehop.name: Pebblehop
pebblehop.story: A cheerful stone-footed explorer that loves trying one more time after a difficult start.

glowfin.name: Glowfin
glowfin.story: A shimmering lake creature that becomes brighter when its friends take good care of themselves.

starwhisk.name: Starwhisk
starwhisk.story: A curious night wanderer said to visit adventurers who complete an especially brave challenge.
